Resources and attribution

Source: vignettes/articles/resources.Rmd
resources.Rmd

Where to find MosaiClusteR

  • CRAN (stable release): https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=MosaiClusteR
  • Source and development (GitHub): https://github.com/lucp12891/MosaiClusteR
  • Report a bug or request a feature: https://github.com/lucp12891/MosaiClusteR/issues
  • Documentation site: https://lucp12891.github.io/MosaiClusteR/

Worked example scripts

Runnable .R versions of the worked examples, ready to download and adapt:

  • quickstart.R: the 60-second quick start.
  • end-to-end.R: a complete analysis, from preprocessing to characterisation.
  • compare-methods.R: run one method per paradigm and compare them by ARI.
  • weighting-and-nuggets.R: feature-weighting schemes, data-nugget compression and nugget clustering.
  • biological-interpretation.R: a template for differential genes and pathway enrichment (needs your own expression data and Bioconductor).

The first four scripts run on the bundled mosaic_toy data; swap in your own list of matrices (objects in rows) to use them on real data.

How to cite

Please cite the package when it contributes to published work.

citation("MosaiClusteR")
@Manual{MosaiClusteR2026,
  title  = {MosaiClusteR: An Umbrella Framework for Multi-Source and
            Multi-Omics Clustering},
  author = {Osang'ir, Bernard Isekah and Van Moerbeke, Marijke and
            Claesen, J\"urgen and Gupta, Surya and Cabrera, Javier and
            Amaratunga, Dhammika and Shkedy, Ziv},
  year   = {2026},
  note   = {R package version 1.0.0},
  url    = {https://github.com/lucp12891/MosaiClusteR}
}

If you use a specific method, please also cite the original work behind it, listed in the references below.

Packages MosaiClusteR builds on

MosaiClusteR implements many methods natively, and interoperates with or wraps a number of other packages. These are declared under Suggests and loaded only when the relevant method is called. Credit for the wrapped functionality belongs to the authors of these packages.

Package Role in MosaiClusteR Source
SNFtool Similarity Network Fusion (SNF) https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=SNFtool
datanugget Reference data-nugget engine (create_data_nuggets(engine = "datanugget")) https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=datanugget
WCluster Weighted clustering primitives used with data nuggets https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=WCluster
LUCIDus Outcome-guided latent clustering (LUCID) https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=LUCIDus
FactoMineR, lsa, analogue Extra distances (MCA, cosine, chi-squared) CRAN
circlize, plotrix, gplots, dendextend Dendrograms, cyclograms, heatmaps CRAN
uwot, Rtsne UMAP and t-SNE embeddings for visualisation CRAN
limma, MLP, biomaRt, org.Hs.eg.db Differential expression and pathway analysis https://bioconductor.org

The core of the package (the integration paradigms, the M-ABC family, the native data-nugget engine, evaluation and the List -> {DistM, Clust} interface) is pure R and compiled C++, with no dependency beyond base R and a small set of imports.

Method references

  • Amaratunga, Cabrera and Shkedy (2008). Exploration and Analysis of DNA Microarray and Other High-Dimensional Data. Wiley. (Aggregating Bundles of Clusters, the basis of the M-ABC family.)
  • Cherasia, Cabrera, Fernholz and Fernholz (2023). Data Nuggets in Supervised Learning. In Robust and Multivariate Statistical Methods, Springer, pages 429 to 449.
  • Wang et al. (2014). Similarity Network Fusion for aggregating data types on a genomic scale. Nature Methods 11, 333 to 337.
  • Rappoport and Shamir (2019). NEMO: cancer subtyping by integration of partial multi-omic data. Bioinformatics.
  • Perualila-Tan et al. (2016). Weighted similarity-based clustering of chemical structures and bioactivity data in early drug discovery.
  • Fodeh, Punch and Tan (2013). On unifying multi-source information for biomedical text and data mining.
  • Strehl and Ghosh (2002). Cluster ensembles: a knowledge reuse framework for combining multiple partitions. (CSPA, HGPA, MCLA.)
  • Fern and Brodley (2004). Solving cluster ensemble problems by bipartite graph partitioning. (HBGF.)
  • Gionis, Mannila and Tsaparas (2007). Clustering aggregation.
  • Nguyen and Caruana (2007). Consensus clusterings. (IVC, IPVC, IPC.)
  • Fred and Jain (2005). Combining multiple clusterings using evidence accumulation.
  • Iam-On et al. (2010). Link-based cluster ensembles. (CTS, SRS, ASRS.)
  • Saeed et al. (2012, 2014). Cumulative voting consensus. (CVAA, W-CVAA.)
  • Zheng, Chen and Zheng (2014). A novel approach for hierarchical ensemble clustering. IEEE TPAMI.
  • Hossain et al. (2012). Ensemble for hierarchical clustering.
  • Chalise and Fridley (2017). Integrative clustering of multi-level omic data based on non-negative matrix factorisation. (intNMF.)
  • Zhao, Jia, Goodrich and Conti (2024). LUCIDus: an R package for latent unknown clustering with integrated data. The R Journal 16(2).
  • Zhang, Zhou, Xu and Liu (2022). Integrative clustering methods for multi-omics data. WIREs Computational Statistics 14, e1553. (Review covering SNF, NEMO, the iCluster family, ab-SNF and CIMLR.)
